rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: Data Protection Law 22/11 of 17 June 2011; the Agência de Protecção de Dados (APD) was set up by Presidential Decree 214/16 of 10 October 2016 with supervisory and sanctioning functions; entities must register with the APD (fees in Presidential Decree 60/21).
